captureMode: natural/opportunistic after Recorder/live-proof gate permits; no manual attack hunting

freezeMinimum.orderedPattern: shortest exact or TM* tail2/tail3/pair/triple with support>=2 for one outcome and oppositeSupport==0
freezeMinimum.stability: targetStable=1.0, sideStable=1.0, retargetFree=1.0 for both outcomes

durabilityPreference.rooms: >=2 for repeated winning branch when natural coverage permits
durabilityPreference.fallback: if not achieved, label branch room/target-conditioned; do not claim universal invariance

secondaryT23.A5888Tail3: one additional unique A5888 cycle repeating exact/TM* tail3 would raise discovery support 1->2; prefer a different room
secondaryT23.A4792_A4920: do not freeze until a branch-specific ordered predicate repeats in >=2 unique cycles
secondaryT23.priorityRelativeToT18: secondary because T23 A5888 already has a research-only manifest while T18 has no ordered manifest

stopCaptureWhen: the above bounded counters are met; do not use a generic 1h/2h duration as the evidence target
